summary: New generic LRU cache with four tests; the LRU ordering itself is effectively untested.

defects.description: `get_returns_inserted_value` puts its only assertion inside `if let Some(v) = c.get(..)`, so the test passes when get returns None; it cannot fail on its own. It should assert_eq!(c.get(&"a"), Some(&1)).

`recently_used_survives_eviction` checks the newly inserted key `c`, not that `a` survived and `b` was evicted, so replacing `touch` with `()` (plain FIFO eviction) survives. The LRU ordering, which is the whole point of the type, is unpinned. The test should assert get(&"a") == Some(&1) and get(&"b") == None.
`updating_existing_key_keeps_size` checks only len(), not that the value changed to 10, so skipping the insert on the update path survives. It also never checks that an update refreshes recency.
